title: A retrospective model predicts levetiracetam response in pediatric epilepsy
summary: The retrospective study analyzed 346 pediatric patients and reports model performance and feature associations. The authors describe associations as hypothesis-generating; prospective clinical utility and benefit from model-guided treatment are not established.
ai_technology: XGBoost combined therapeutic drug monitoring measurements and ABCB1 genotype to predict treatment response; SHAP was used to interpret model features.
